title: Tactical commands
description: Commands a tactical controller returns for an activation: the same set a player issues. The tactical layer validates and resolves each; illegal commands are rejected. There is no takeCover command: taking cover is move / changeStance, or setReaction with reaction takeCover (TAI-005). Spec: TAI-005, TAI-006, TAI-016, TAC-005..TAC-084.

log.description: Decision log: turn, unit, chosen command, top-N options with survival, goal, fit and coordination scores (TAI-016)

shells.description: reload, tube-fed: shells to load (partial reload)

unit.description: activate: unit to activate; useItem: treated soldier (self or adjacent); restrainVip: the VIP

target.description: shoot: target unit ID; search, pickUp, cutLock, placeCharge, pickUpBackpack, liftBody: object or body ID

tile.description: shoot at a tile, throwGrenade target, vault or climb point

edge.description: closeDoor: the door's tile edge {tile, side} (TAC-084); a closed unlocked door on a move path opens as part of the move

item.description: throwGrenade, useItem, pickUp, placeCharge: item instance

sourceSlot.description: Equipment slot the item or magazine comes from (backpack surcharge, TAC-068)

exit.description: leaveMap: exit id from the tactical map request / map (TAC-038)
